analysis: The runtimeVersions dictionary records benchmarkVariant and minimumIOS. The analyzer already includes the entire runtimeVersions dictionary in cell identities. A regression verifies variants are not pooled even on the same device/OS/block.
This package excludes unused MLX/ExecuTorch frameworks. Process footprint and startup may therefore differ from baseline packaging independently of hardware.
Hardware generation, OS version and lab conditions remain confounded. Do not claim hardware-only causation.
All original seven-runtime study requirements and raw results remain. This adds older-device GGUF coverage and does not replace delegate/newer-device replication.

controls.cachePolicies: Retained prefix, matched recorded-history fresh replay, interruption reset/recovery as in the parent protocol.
controls.loadAndThermal: Same isolated adapter loads, nominal cooldown limit, low-power checks and 50ms footprint sampling as in the parent protocol.

excludedConfigurations: O2/O4/O6/O7 remain in the newer-OS packages. Their absence in this package is not a hardware/runtime failure.
gates: Signed Xcode 26.2 package, actual binary/native minimum OS inspection, source-before/after receipt and immutable package/source hashes.
Local smoke and S1 study validation of the new exact package before any older-device cloud submission.
Concrete paid-execution approval before each new cloud job.
Cloud smoke must demonstrate successful model acquisition and inference on the actual older OS before replication claims.
localValidationDevice: iPhone17,3 on its actual installed iOS, not an iOS 16.6 compatibility test
reason: Firebase older-generation catalog phones offer only iOS 16.6. The pinned MLX and ExecuTorch SwiftPM packages declare iOS 17 minimums, and the existing delegate harness requires iOS 18.
